translations.web: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
translations.bsb: O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong. When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
translations.kjv: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
translations.asv: Thou, Jehovah, of thy favor hadst made my mountain to stand strong: Thou didst hide thy face; I was troubled.
